SitePartDef.label: mature Wraith Hive
SitePartDef.description: A functioning Wraith feeding settlement belonging to one exact lineage. Its local population, hibernators, feeding stock and replacement cycle exist physically on the generated site map.
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: A mature Wraith Hive occupies this region. Its inhabitants maintain real feeding stock, hibernation chambers and a bounded local replacement cycle.

SitePartDef.label: Wraith holding site
SitePartDef.description: A temporary Wraith holding site containing exact pawns taken by culling technology. Defeating or diplomatically neutralizing the guards releases those same captives.
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: This Wraith site is holding people removed by culling technology. The captives are the exact pawns who were taken.
